quandoUsar: Messenger-style conversations: the person's bubbles sit on the right in the accent color and the assistant's on the left on a neutral surface.
Sequences of messages from the same sender: `MessageBubbleGroup` tightens the inner corners and leaves the tail only on the last bubble.
When the sent message should show time and delivery state (`sending`, `sent`, `delivered`, `read`, `failed`) or the other party is typing (`typing`).
quandoEvitar: Use `message` for long assistant replies, with Markdown and a toolbar for copy, retry and rating.
Use `chat-thread` when you need the ready-made conversation, with reactions, read receipts, typing indicator and input field.
Use `chat-app` when you want the whole chat screen, with conversation list and prompt box.
acessibilidade: Each bubble starts with the author for screen readers only (“You”, “Assistant” or the `author` you pass), and the delivery state has a hidden text equivalent to the ticks.
The typing dots are a `role="status"` with `aria-label` “Typing”; `MessageBubbleGroup` is a `role="group"` that gets its name from `label`.
The bubble does not create a live region for new messages: put the list in a container with that role, such as `message-scroller`, which uses `role="log"`.
movimento: The bubble emerges from the tail corner, growing and rising with a spring with a slight bounce; `animateIn={false}` turns this off for history.
Each new tick draws itself when `status` changes (those already there on mount do not repeat); `sending` shows a small spin and `typing`, three dots in a wave.
With “reduce motion” on, the bubble and ticks only fade, and the spin and dots stay still.
responsivo: The bubble takes at most 82% of the container width, up to 34rem; the text preserves line breaks and breaks long words.
notasIA: Group consecutive messages from the same sender in a `MessageBubbleGroup from="user"`: it sets `from` and `position` on each child, which must be direct `MessageBubble`s (a wrapper in between breaks this).
`timestamp` arrives already formatted (for example “9:41”) and `status` draws the ticks; in a group, pass both only on the last bubble, as the demo does.
For the typing indicator, render a bubble with `typing` and swap it for the message when the text arrives; outside groups, `position` and `tail` control corners and tail.
